positioning.heading: Built by a Business Owner, for Business Owners.
positioning.copy:
Business owners should not have to buy random marketing services and hope something works.

SBMC begins by understanding the business, its customers, location, current presentation, and biggest challenge. We then recommend a practical starting point the owner can clearly understand.

steps.title: Understand

steps.title: Analyze
steps.description: We identify the most important problem or opportunity affecting trust, visibility, communication, or enquiries.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: We create the solution that your business genuinely needs instead of forcing a large package.

steps.title: Grow
